subsetPolicyRationale: `s.norm.en1991@1` is this plugin's own self-contained Eurocode EN 1991 actions-on-structures document — there is no alternate conformance profile, encoding variant or standard subclass to split against: every mutation (change-area-m2, change-category, change-annex, change-self-weight-material, change-self-weight-thickness-m, change-assumed-gk-kn-m2, …) reads and writes the SAME single value model this plugin owns, through the SAME codec/dispatch regardless of which field or entity it touches. `✳️any` remains this artifact's only real scope.
